items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: After me, they had Johnny Mehegan up there, but it wasn't broad like Berklee, it was just piano only.

ctx.x: So maybe who's ever setting up the curriculum at Juilliard now, Shuman doesn't concern himself with it, I don't know. But they dropped it -- well, they never really went all out with jazz. After me, they had Johnny Mehegan up there, but it wasn't broad like Berklee, it was just piano only.
